METALWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: METALWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

2. When learning Project 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 2.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 2.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Project 2.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 2.

3. When learning Heat treatment of steel, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Heat treatment of steel.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Heat treatment of steel.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Heat treatment of steel.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Heat treatment of steel.

4. When learning Metalwork related businesses, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metalwork related businesses.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork related businesses.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork related businesses.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Metalwork related businesses.

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

6. When learning Centre La, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Centre La.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Centre La.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Centre La.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Centre La.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

8. When learning Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.

9. When learning Gas Welding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Gas Welding.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Gas Welding.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Gas Welding.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Gas Welding.

10. When learning Assembly Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawings.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawings.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawings.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawings.

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Run with the tool

12. When learning Forging, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Forging.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Forging.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Forging.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Forging.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Project 2 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Career Opportunities in Metalwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Metalwork related businesses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Heat treatment of steel and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

6. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Centre La.

7. C — CPU

9. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Gas Welding.

10. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawings.

11. B — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

12. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Forging.
